text:
alex: trying to press release v1.9.2 now, can someone claim deploy? deploy-bot showed 'no claim'

maya: hold — I'm already in a claim for the data-migration change window

alex: oh? I didn't see a claim message. did you use deploy-bot or manual? :thinking:

maya: deploy-bot claim started a few mins ago, I ran the canary job — still running

alex: can we coordinate? our rollback fix for the embed cache is gated on the deploy.

deploy-bot: Claim acquired by maya. Release queued: release:v1.9.2, canary 10%, region=us-west

ryan: fyi SSO/MFA rotation earlier broke deployer role for some users — if alex can't claim, it might be that their mfa device isn't registered. check PAM logs

alex: confirmed MFA prompt failed when I tried. Getting 'user not in deployer-group' too. :lock:

sre-oncall: quick plan: maya completes canary, if metrics OK, we let maya press. If we need rollback, I can elevate alex for one-time JIT following the emergency procedure. Need approval from team leads.

maya: metrics look good at 12m. CPU spike tiny. proceeding to 100% now.

alex: if we need to rollback, what's the exact command? I have the older pinned build ready.

sre-oncall: rollback command: `deploy revert --to v1.9.1 --force --reason "embed-cache-fix-rollforward-failed"` — I'll prepare the JIT token for alex now.

ryan: I'll open a short-lived group membership ticket so alex can press within the change window. ETA 3m.

sophia: leaving a note — pin v1.9.1 in the release manifest if we end up rolling back. Also add a postmortem tag: release/2026-05-03

deploy-bot: Release v1.9.2 rolled to 100% in us-west. Notifications sent. :tada:

alex: thanks — will monitor. if anything odd in 15m ping here and I'll take the revert.
